// stats_correlate

simulator lang=spectre

parameters a=1 b=2 c=3
statistics {
    process {
        vary a dist=gauss std=100m
        vary b dist=gauss std=200m percent=yes
        vary c dist=gauss std=300m
        truncate tr=4
    }
    correlate param=[a b] cc=600m
}

r1 (x 0) resistor r=a+b+c
i1 (0 x) isource dc=1m

op1 dc
